name: Nicknames
category: Community - Features that build community interaction.
purpose: Allows members to choose how SYNARA addresses them during conversations.
notes:
Nicknames are shared across every server where both you and SYNARA are present.
Running the command again replaces the existing nickname.
Running the command without a nickname removes the saved nickname.
Nicknames should remain appropriate for all audiences.
SYNARA may reject nicknames that violate community standards.

commands.name: !nickname <nickname>
commands.description: Sets or updates your preferred nickname.

commands.name: !nickname
commands.description: Removes your saved nickname.

name: Draw
category: Engagement - Features that encourage conversation and participation.
purpose: Allows members to collaborate with SYNARA by generating simple sketches based on their ideas, encouraging creativity and experimentation within the community.
notes:
Be as descriptive as possible for the best results.
Occasionally SYNARA may experience a harmless drawing glitch that intentionally adds personality to the feature.
Experiment with different ideas and prompts for unique results.

commands.name: !draw <description>
commands.description: Generates a sketch based on your prompt.

name: Birthdays
category: Community - Features that build community interaction.
purpose: Helps celebrate members of your community by remembering their birthday and automatically announcing it each year, creating a more welcoming and engaging server.
notes:
Birthdays are entered using the MM/DD format.
A birth year is never requested or stored.
Running !birthday again replaces the previously saved birthday.
The Happy Birthday role is optional and only assigned if configured by the server.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.

commands.name: !birthday
commands.description: Registers or updates your birthday.

commands.name: !nextBirthday
commands.description: Displays birthdays occurring during the next three months.

name: Sticky Messages
category: Administration - Administrative tools and moderation features.
purpose: Keeps important information visible by automatically moving a designated message back to the bottom of a channel after conversations have slowed down.
notes:
Only one sticky message may exist per channel.
Sticky messages remain in the channel where they were created.
The five-minute delay prevents unnecessary reposting during active conversations.
Sticky messages are ideal for instructions, server information, and frequently referenced content.

commands.name: /sticky create
commands.description: Creates a sticky message in the current channel.

commands.name: /sticky delete
commands.description: Removes the sticky message from the current channel.

name: Custom Embeds
category: Administration - Administrative tools and moderation features.
purpose: Allows administrators to create professional-looking announcements and informational messages that appear as though they were posted directly by SYNARA.
notes:
Embeds are posted in the same channel where the command is used.
Every embed includes a private approval step before being published.
Cancelling the preview prevents the embed from being posted.

commands.name: /embed
commands.description: Creates a custom embed in the current channel after administrator approval.

name: Event Announcements
category: Automation - Background systems that operate automatically.
purpose: Automatically informs your community whenever a new Discord Event is created, helping members stay informed about upcoming activities without requiring administrators to manually post announcements.
notes:
SYNARA automatically announces newly created Discord Events.
Members with the configured Verified role are notified of new events.
If an event begins within 30 minutes of being created, SYNARA skips the creation announcement and only posts the "Event Starting Now" announcement.
Event announcements are generated automatically whenever a Discord Event is created.

name: Scheduled Events
category: Administration - Administrative tools and moderation features.
purpose: Allows administrators to create recurring or one-time announcements that SYNARA automatically posts on a configurable schedule.
notes:
Scheduled events currently use UTC (UTC+0) when selecting dates and times.
Recurring events continue automatically until paused or deleted.
One-time events are automatically removed after they have been posted.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.

commands.name: /event Create Scheduled Event
commands.description: Creates a new scheduled announcement.

commands.name: /event Manage Scheduled Event
commands.description: Manages an existing scheduled event, including pause, resume, skip, edit, and delete.

name: Counting Penalties
category: Automation - Background systems that operate automatically.
purpose: Automatically tracks counting game failures and assigns a temporary Counting Penalty role to the member responsible for the most recent reset.
notes:
SYNARA does not control the counting game itself.
A separate counting bot validates numbers.
Only one member can have the Counting Penalty role at a time.
The role automatically moves to the next member who breaks the counting sequence.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.
requiredSettings:
Counting Channel
Counting Penalty Role
Counting Bot

name: Bonks
category: Community - Features that build community interaction.
purpose: Provides a lighthearted community game where members can playfully bonk one another while SYNARA tracks each member's bonk count.
notes:
Bonks are intended to be fun and playful.
Rare self-bonks are completely random.
SYNARA tracks each member's total number of bonks.
Bonks have no moderation effects and do not punish users.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.

commands.name: !bonk @user
commands.description: Attempts to bonk another member.

name: Efficiency Points
category: Community - Features that build community interaction.
purpose: Provides a fun virtual currency system that lets members compare their progress and activity within the community.
notes:
Efficiency Points have no monetary value.
The system exists purely for community engagement and friendly competition.
Members can compare their progress as they participate in the community.

commands.name: !points
commands.description: Displays your current Efficiency Point total.

name: Twitch Monitoring
category: Automation - Background systems that operate automatically.
purpose: Automatically monitors linked Twitch accounts and announces live streams from active community members while providing additional visibility for leadership streams.
notes:
Twitch usernames must be entered exactly as they appear on Twitch.
Live announcements are intended to support active community members rather than function as a live-link directory.
Server Leader streams receive additional visibility through automatic Discord Event creation.
Members may unlink and relink their Twitch account at any time.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.
requiredSettings:
Leadership Stream Channel
Self Promotion Channel

commands.name: !linkTwitch <twitch_username>
commands.description: Links your Twitch account to SYNARA.

commands.name: !unlinkTwitch
commands.description: Removes your linked Twitch account.

commands.name: !myTwitch
commands.description: Displays the Twitch account currently linked to your Discord account.

commands.name: !twitchStats
commands.description: Displays your tracked Twitch streaming statistics.

name: Onboarding
category: Automation - Background systems that operate automatically.
purpose: Welcomes new members by guiding them through verification and directing them to important channels needed to get started in the community.
notes:
The Verified role must be configured by the server administrators.
SYNARA will only assign the configured Verified role.
The Roles and Introductions channels should be configured before enabling this feature.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.
requiredSettings:
Welcome Channel
Roles Channel
Introductions Channel

name: Observations
category: Automation - Background systems that operate automatically.
purpose: Allows SYNARA to naturally participate in conversations by selectively responding when she can meaningfully contribute to discussions.
notes:
SYNARA only monitors channels that are not on the ignored channel list.
She intentionally avoids responding to low-information messages, acknowledgements, emotes, GIFs, and similar content.
Observations are designed to enhance conversations rather than dominate them.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.

commands.name: /ignoreChannel Add
commands.description: Prevents SYNARA from monitoring the current channel.

commands.name: /ignoreChannel Remove
commands.description: Allows SYNARA to resume monitoring the current channel.

commands.name: /settings
commands.description: Displays the server's configured settings, including ignored channels.

name: Moderator Applications
category: Administration - Administrative tools and moderation features.
purpose: Provides a structured and private application system that allows members to apply for moderator positions while giving administrators complete control over the review process.
notes:
Applications contain fifteen questions divided into three sections.
Submitted applications remain private and are only visible to server administrators.
Previous moderators are not eligible to reapply.
Blacklisted users cannot submit moderator applications.
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.
requiredSettings:
Moderator Application Channel
Moderator Submission Channel

commands.name: /modapps Open
commands.description: Opens moderator applications.

commands.name: /modapps Close
commands.description: Closes moderator applications.

commands.name: /modapps Blacklist Add
commands.description: Prevents a user from submitting future applications.

commands.name: /modapps Blacklist Remove
commands.description: Removes a user from the application blacklist.

commands.name: /modapps Blacklist List
commands.description: Displays all currently blacklisted users.

name: Question of the Day
category: Engagement - Features that encourage conversation and participation.
purpose: Automatically posts a thought-provoking question each morning to encourage meaningful discussion and participation throughout the community.
notes:
Questions are intended to encourage meaningful discussion rather than simple yes-or-no answers.
SYNARA includes her own commentary with each question to help begin the conversation.
Posting time is based on Eastern Time (8:00 AM) and UTC (12:00 PM).
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.

name: Nightly Motivational
category: Engagement - Features that encourage conversation and participation.
purpose: Automatically posts a motivational quote and SYNARA's reflection each evening to inspire discussion, self-reflection, and positive community interaction.
notes:
Quotes and reflections are generated automatically.
The feature is intended to encourage positive discussion within the community.
Posting time is based on Eastern Time (8:00 PM) and UTC (12:00 AM).
This feature may be enabled or disabled by administrators.

name: Trivia
category: Engagement - Features that encourage conversation and participation.
purpose: Challenges members with trivia questions across a variety of topics while tracking long-term performance and leaderboard rankings.
notes:
Trivia statistics are tracked over time.
Leaderboards encourage friendly competition within the community.
Everyone has an opportunity to climb the rankings by continuing to participate.

commands.name: !trivia
commands.description: Starts a trivia session.

commands.name: !leaderboard
commands.description: Displays your trivia statistics and the community leaderboard.

name: Jokes
category: Engagement - Features that encourage conversation and participation.
purpose: Gives members a lighthearted way to interact with SYNARA through original jokes and her own unique sense of humor.
notes:
Humor is intended to be fun and community-friendly.
SYNARA's commentary is part of the overall experience.

commands.name: !joke
commands.description: Generates a joke.

name: Facts
category: Engagement - Features that encourage conversation and participation.
purpose: Lets members discover interesting real-world facts while hearing SYNARA's own perspective on what makes each fact interesting.
notes:
Facts cover a wide variety of subjects.
SYNARA's commentary is intended to add personality to every response.

commands.name: !fact
commands.description: Generates a random fact.
